text:
Maya: Heads-up — noticed dashboard embed examples in the Console docs break when locale param contains a plus sign (e.g. zh+CN).
Ajay: repro steps? can you paste the failing URL?
Maya: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/observability/dashboard?preset=heatmap&locale=zh+CN -> 404 redirect loop :facepalm:
Tom: likely URL encoding issue in the snippet generator that writes the iframe src. I saw similar in the presets PR last month.
Elena: is this affecting only the embed example or the live playground too?
Maya: both — playground iframe constructs the same src using the param set from the sample YAML.
Ajay: ok filing a quick PR for the snippet generator to url-encode params and update the example templates. assigning to me.
Tom: please also change the SDK snippet param name — we still ship examples using `traceKey` (camelCase) but our SDK expects `trace_key` now. That mismatch may be causing missing trace linking in the examples.
Maya: good catch. Where does that live? which files to change?
Ajay: docs/snippets/embed.yaml, docs/snippets/console_playground.json, and the python/rust examples under examples/observability/*
Gabe: FYI the internal redirect we get (old /dash -> /dashboard) makes it worse because plus signs are turned into spaces by the redirector.
Elena: can someone add a regression test so this doesn't slip back in? a simple integration test that asserts the iframe src contains encoded params would do.
Ajay: adding a small pytest in docs_tests/test_embed_params.py. snippet:
```
def test_iframe_params_encoded(render_snippet):
    src = render_snippet('embed.yaml')['iframe_src']
    assert '+' not in src
    assert '%2B' in src or '%20' not in src
```
Maya: nice. also need a quick note in the migration guide about `traceKey` -> `trace_key` so community contributors don't keep using the old name.
Tom: I'll open a follow-up PR to the migration doc and add a changelog bullet under "SDK snippet param updates".
Ajay: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — includes encode patch + python/rust snippet rename + unit test. reviewers: @Tom, @Elena.
Elena: reviewing now. small nit: adjust the inline code block in the embed example to use single quotes around the query string so markdown renderers don't try to interpret it.
Gabe: quick link check: update internal alias from /dash to /dashboard?preset=heatmap -> added redirect-safe encoding in nginx config (infra ticket #1342). I pushed a short note to the PR.
Maya: great — once CI passes can we backport to stable branch? some customers link the stable docs directly.
Ajay: yes, will cut a backport PR to release/docs-stable after merge.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR 4821 :white_check_mark: — tests: docs-lint, snippet-unit, linkcheck
Tom: merging now. :tada:
Maya: thanks all — follow-up issues: add a small e2e for playground iframe in the docs CI and sweep other examples for camelCase params.
Elena: created issue #499 for sweeping examples.
Gabe: leaving a note in the release checklist so backport happens in the next patch release.
Maya: awesome. closing thread once backport PR is merged.
